name: wobble-card

frames.best_why: Card is shifted off centre with the pointer inside, showing the tilt and parallax.

tagline: Blue gradient card leans toward the cursor as its text drifts the other way.
summary: A rounded content card with an indigo gradient and faint grain. The whole card follows the pointer a little, and the text inside slides opposite and scales slightly for depth.
appearance: A rounded card filled with an indigo-to-violet gradient that glows lighter at the top, holding a bold white heading and two lines of pale body copy left-aligned. A soft radial highlight and faint grain cover the surface.
behaviour: Moving the pointer over the card nudges it toward the cursor while the inner text shifts the opposite way and grows a touch. It settles back to centre when the pointer leaves.
demo_content: Heading 'Ship faster.' and a short paragraph about a card that tilts on mouse move.
search_phrases: card that tilts toward the mouse
card that shifts under the cursor
depth effect on a content tile
hero tile that leans while you move
use_when: A feature or promo card should feel physical and respond to the cursor without a full 3D scene.
avoid_when: The tilt is mouse-only, so touch users get a still card, and the indigo gradient is fixed.
customise: Drop any heading and copy in as children; adjust the outer size and inner padding with containerClassName and className. The indigo gradient, shadow and noise image are fixed.
weight_why: One card with a couple of CSS transform transitions and a static noise image.

a11y.note: The tilt is decorative and pointer-only; there is no keyboard or touch equivalent and no reduced-motion guard.

issues: The tilt is so slight in the frames that hover is hard to tell from rest.
The grain comes from a hardcoded /noise.webp path, so it may 404 in another setup.
polish_why: Rich indigo gradient and clean type; the tilt is subtle and the grain relies on an external image.
